pages.title: Bifurcations
pages.text: $(thing)Bifurcations$()$(br2)Turn a setting slowly and, at one value, a steady state turns unstable and the system starts to oscillate: the Belousov reaction's threshold, and a heartbeat's.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Stability, Oscillating Reactions.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Stability Margin, 1 Chemical Clock.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): In the Brusselator with feeds A and B the steady state turns unstable, and the mixture oscillates, past one value of B. Write that value H.
